Sam (PM): Short sync on Finance Kit scope. Customers want per-route chargeback CSVs, trace links for audits, and an error fingerprint table. We have 2 engineers half-time. Can we do a constrained MVP?

Iris (Eng-Platform): Yes. MVP = aggregated CSV exports (per-route/time window) marked ESTIMATED + a small index from route->sampled_trace_ids. Exact per-invocation attribution is GA-only. estimate: 2 sprints for MVP.

Noah (Eng-ML): We can emit est_cost and confidence_pct using model token profiles. Recommend adaptive sampling: higher for errors and high-cost outliers.

Priya (CS): Customers accept Preview if clearly labeled and with a migration path to Dedicated exact metrics. I'll recruit 2 pilot customers.

notifier-bot: Created ticket FINKIT-210: "finance kit MVP: aggregated exports + trace linking + fingerprints" assigned to eng-platform, eng-ml. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FINKIT-210

Sam (PM): Acceptance criteria for MVP:
- UI: Finance page with route selector, time-range, export CSV button.
- CSV columns: [route, start_ts, end_ts, tokens_est, est_cost, confidence_pct, note=ESTIMATED].
- Trace link: route -> sampled traces (min 3 when available).
- Fingerprint view: top 20 fingerprints with sample trace ids.

Iris (Eng-Platform): Risk: estimator drift from runtime changes. We'll include model_version and batching_mode in metrics.

Noah (Eng-ML): I'll run a 3-day spike to validate estimator accuracy and share plots.

Sam (PM): Thanks all ":thumbsup:"
